<Class I Specified Chemical Substances>
- License for manufacture/import (Prohibited besides essential use)
- Import prohibition on products designated by Cabinet Order
- Recovery order, etc.

<Contents of regulation>
 Prohibition of the production, placing on the market and use of substances listed in Annex I.
 Restriction of the production, placing on the market and use of substances listed in Annex II.
<Applicable substances>
 Substances specified in Stockholm Convention or POPs Protocol.
 Articles and wastes containing the specified substances.
<Exemptions from control measures>
 a substance present as an unintentional trace contaminant, as specified in the relevant entries of Annex I or II, in substances, mixtures or articles.
The United States is not a party to the POPs Convention. Therefore, the regulation of the targeted substances is governed by individual laws.
